name: White Petal
body:
[Source: GB19]

The most common of the drugs on the market derived from harpy jasmine, white petal causes a mild, dreamy high that lends itself to restful sleep.

DETAIL

Type injury (injected); Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 13; Price 60 gp

EFFECT

10 hours; –2 penalty to initiative checks and regain an additional 1d4 hit points when recovering hit points naturally. During this time, gain detect magic as a spell-like ability (CL 2nd), usable three times.

DAMAGE

1d2 Charisma damage
